title: Apex class ignores sharing rules (apex) — review required
description: An Apex class declares without sharing, so record access ignores the running user sharing rules. Callers may read or change records they cannot reach in the UI. This lexical rule flags the declaration; the reviewer confirms the class enforces its own access checks.
remediation: Declare the class with sharing, or enforce access explicitly.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any without sharing declaration matches, including system-context jobs that need it.
